description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseAudioFilter' for audio filter implementations in an input transport pipeline. It provides method signatures for starting, stopping, processing control frames, and filtering audio data, intended for subclasses to implement actual filtering logic.

classes.name: BaseAudioFilter
classes.description: An abstract base class for input transport audio filters, providing a standardized interface for initializing, stopping, processing control frames, and filtering audio data.

methods.name: start(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Initializes the filter when the input transport starts, configured with the sample rate.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the input transport stops.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: FilterControlFrame)
methods.description: Processes control frames for runtime filter configuration, such as updates or enable/disable commands.

methods.name: bytes filter(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Applies the audio filter to the provided audio bytes, returning the filtered audio.

ctags.name: filter
ctags.pattern: /^    async def filter(self, audio: bytes) -> bytes:$/
